scenarios.name: Normal
scenarios.description: Representative rainfall: 0-50 mm. River remains largely within channel.

scenarios.name: Moderate
scenarios.description: Representative rainfall: 50-80 mm. Localized bank overflow.

scenarios.name: Heavy
scenarios.description: Representative rainfall: 80-150 mm. Substantial river rise, larger connected floodplain inundation.

scenarios.name: Extreme
scenarios.description: Representative rainfall: 150-250 mm. Largest river rise and infrastructure exposure.
